How to use Rushes

For anyone who spends too long choosing a film, for households that subscribe to several streaming services, and for film students and filmmakers who want to study what they watch.

Open Rushes ↗Platform detailsContact

Guided tourReal screens

Plays automatically. Use the dots or arrows to move, Pause to stop.

01

Getting started

1

Go to rushes-film.vercel.app. No account is needed.

2

The first trailer starts without sound. Press Sound off to turn the sound on and use the slider for the volume.

3

Scroll down for the next film, or pick a genre at the top.

4

Press Watch it to save a film or Not for me to hide it.

5

Press Story + where to open the film's panel, and My list to see what you saved.

02

Features

01

The feed

One film fills the screen with its title, year, length, rating, genres, where it streams and a short synopsis. The trailer plays behind them and the next film starts when it ends.

STEPS

  1. Scroll or use the arrow keys to move between films
  2. Tap the picture to pause or resume
  3. Choose a genre in the bar at the top
02

Where to watch and the plot

The film's panel lists the services that stream, rent or sell it in your country, then the plot, its themes, and a fact sheet with release date, certificate, country, languages, studio, budget, box office and audience score.

STEPS

  1. Press Story + where on any film
  2. Read the services under Where to watch
  3. Scroll for the cast, the crew and more clips
03

For filmmakers

Each lesson opens into three parts: what to look for, why it works, and an exercise. The first gives the likely turning points in minutes for that film. Others cover its genres, six crafts headed by the person credited, the budget against the box office, and how the trailer is built. The lessons are general teaching matched to the film, not a review of it.

STEPS

  1. Open the film's panel and scroll to For filmmakers
  2. Open a lesson
  3. Do the exercise under Try it yourself
04

My list

The films you chose to watch, each with its year and where it streams. The list stays on the device you used.

STEPS

  1. Press Watch it on a film
  2. Open My list at the top right
  3. Press Details to reopen a film or Drop to remove it
03Tips
  • Turn a phone sideways: trailers are widescreen and fill the screen that way.
  • Use Not for me freely. Hidden films do not come back, so the feed gets closer to your taste.
  • The full film plays in the streaming service's own app. Rushes tells you which one.
04FAQ
Can I watch the whole film in Rushes?

No. Rushes plays trailers and clips and shows which services carry the film.

Do I need an account?

No. Your list is kept on your device and is not shared between devices.

Where does the information come from?

Film data and images come from TMDB and streaming availability from JustWatch. The lessons for filmmakers are written for Rushes.

Which languages?

The interface and the film information are in English.
